subject: [PATCH 1/2] mm/page_alloc: detect zonelist rebuilds from memory hot-add

reviews.author: Vlastimil Babka (SUSE)
reviews.summary: Reviewed the patch and found it acceptable, but noted that no changes were made in response to their review. They explicitly gave a Reviewed-by tag.

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch series addresses a race condition in the zonelist update sequence, specifically when memory hot-add is enabled. The issue arises from concurrent GFP_KERNEL and __GFP_THISNODE allocations observing intermediate list states during zonelist rebuilds. To fix this, the patch gates the sequence checks on CONFIG_MEMORY_HOTPLUG, ensuring that every configuration that rebuilds zonelists after boot is covered.
